prose: Adam Stevens, aka Mr. Permie Bear, joins InnerVerse to talk about his exodus to Beartaria, how he left the world of banking and finance behind to start minting a new currency, through the infinite abundance of seeds. As one of the men behind Grateful Harvest Seed Company, Adam now provides his rural Missouri community with ancient kernels of life-giving magic, with endless return on investment. We'll also discuss the need for authentic community as society diverges into parallel heaven and hell systems, healthy soil tactics, the wealth of family, and much more.
